correctness.rationale: Rotational invariance and first-Hermite STFT overlap diagonalize the operator with λ_n=∫ e^-u u^{n−1}(u−n)²/n! du. For R=s+L/2 and n=R+x√R, fixed-area symmetric integration and Stirling give L/√(2πR)[f(x)+R^-1/2g(x)+O(R^-1)] with f=x²e^-x²/2, g=f(x)(x³−3x)/6. f has exactly two positive global maxima x=±√2 of height 2/e and strict negative curvature. At these points the correction is ±(2/e)(√2/6), so M_-−M_+=2L/(3e√π R)+O(R^-3/2)>0. Chernoff tails exclude remote n and a differentiable peak perturbation plus lattice rounding gives optimizing n=R−√(2R)+O(1). Independent symbolic substitution confirmed the opposite ±√2/6 corrections. The other positive peak persists as local max. θ etc irrelevant. Reproducing normalization requires ∑_n Poisson(u,n)(u−n)²/u=1; user-supplied code checks finitely, proof uses exact variance identity.
